title: "Father's Whereabouts"
next_chapter_hook: "The fate card in Ye Qing's hand, emanating a ghostly glow, seemed to mock Chen Ji's hesitation—and on its blurred surface, the outline faintly resembled his own face..."

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't know how he made it back to that decrepit servants' quarters. He only knew his legs felt like they were filled with lead, each step weighing a thousand catties. The moment he pushed the door open, twilight squeezed through the gaps, pinning his entire body to the threshold. Father. That name exploded in his mind like thunder striking a dead silent abyss. Chen Tianming—his kin whom he thought had long turned to dry bones, was actually still alive in this world? Chen Ji clenched his fists so hard his fingernails burrowed deep into his palms, blood dripping onto the green bricks of the floor, blooming into dark red flowers. He felt no pain. That suffocating cramping in his chest had already eclipsed every ounce of physical suffering. Fifteen years. A full fifteen years, he had eeked out a miserable existence in the Tianqing Sect under the jeers of '废物', and every time someone trampled him into the dust, he thought—if father were still alive, he would come to save me. But father never came. He thought father was dead. He had hated, resented, woken in the dead of night clutching his mother's memorial tablet and weeping until he lost his voice. But now someone told him, father was alive. Right in the depths of the imperial city, in a place beyond his reach."

"Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to冷静下来. He was Chen Ji—that Chen Ji who had strategies without equal, who walked the world under the persona of a废物. Emotion solved no problems—this he understood better than anyone. From his bosom he produced a broken transmission talisman, a hidden棋子 set down many years ago, pointing to a secret intelligence network on the outskirts of the imperial city. With his current status, reaching the core of the imperial city was impossible. But these underground operators were different. They recognized only money, not people. More importantly—they had no idea who he was. The transmission talisman silently activated, Chen Ji lowering his voice: 'Investigate Chen Tianming. Tianqing Sect veteran, vanished twenty years ago. Imperial city, most likely in some sealed zone.' After sending the message, he leaned against the wall, eyes closed. The heart in his chest was still racing wildly, but his thoughts were gradually clearing. However father survived and why he was trapped in the imperial city—all of this required intelligence. And patience? He had that in abundance."

dialogue.content: "(Fingertips tapping lightly on the desk, the rhythm unhurried) The abandoned old observatory site at the northwestern corner of the imperial city. Three years ago, someone saw anomalous light from that area, as if some prohibition was triggered. Can you be certain?"

text.content: "The reply came faster than expected. The moment the transmission talisman vibrated, Chen Ji practically launched himself off the wall. That voice was hoarse and cautious, carrying the oiliness unique to information brokers: 'Chen Tianming... you're talking about that Tianqing Sect genius? The one who vanished overnight twenty years ago?' Chen Ji offered no answer, letting the silence apply pressure for him. After a moment, the other continued: 'Fine, I'll be direct. Northwest of the imperial city, beneath the observatory ruins, there's an underground heavenly prison. Those imprisoned there are all important criminals who discovered things they shouldn't have. One of my associates died there three years ago, and before he died, he transmitted one phrase—'Chen Tianming is still alive, but he'd be better off dead.'' Chen Ji's hand tightened violently. The transmission talisman emitted a harsh creaking sound in his palm, but he was oblivious. Still alive. But better off dead. These eight words were like a blunt blade, carving away at his heart one cut at a time."

"Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, deep within his pupils burning a cold, ghostly flame. Still alive—these three words should have been hope, yet at this moment they weighed heavier than the worst news. He discovered the transaction between the dynasty and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? What did that mean? It meant father wasn't imprisoned because his strength was insufficient, but because he knew too much. Those people—the dynasty's power brokers, possibly including the Eye of Heavenly Secrets itself—they didn't kill father, but chose to imprison him instead. This in itself was a warning and a torment. Let you live, watch everything you protected gradually collapse. Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile was chillingly cold, like the bitter wind of the twelfth lunar month. He recalled many things: his mother clutching his hand on her deathbed saying 'survive,' the mocking faces when he was trampled beneath feet in the Tianqing Sect, that suffocating feeling every time he used the Tianji Record—the sensation of being gradually devoured by fate. So it turned out none of this was coincidence from the beginning. The Chen family's bloodline had been arranged long ago."

dialogue.content: "(Voice pressed extremely low, carrying a dangerous calm) How much Heavenly Fate does he have left? At his current condition, how long can he hold on?"

text.content: "The information broker was silent for a long time. When he spoke again, there was an indefinable wariness in his tone: 'This... guest, some things are beyond what I can touch. I can only tell you that the guards at the observatory heavenly prison have been replaced batch after batch, but one position has never been vacant—the 'Life Guardian.' It's said the person in that position specializes in extracting... something... from the prisoners.' Chen Ji's heart completely sank. Life Guardian. Extracting Heavenly Fate. Wasn't this exactly what he had been doing? Except he consumed it voluntarily, while his father was being forcibly stripped. Two methods, one result—the final destiny is death. The transmission talisman gradually cooled in his hand, yet Chen Ji felt no temperature. He stood in the dim servants' quarters, everything around him seeming to recede into the distance. Father's situation was far more desperate than he imagined, and that so-called 'transaction' was probably far more terrifying than the relationship between the dynasty and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji gripped the transmission talisman tightly, his knuckles white. Father's situation was clear, but the road to the imperial city was fraught with danger. He had to make a choice—activate the Tianji Record immediately to deduce a rescue plan, or remain inactive and continue gathering intelligence?"

choices.description: "Consume 5 Heavenly Fate to foresee the critical timing and path for rescuing father within the next three hours"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain precise rescue timing window and route"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate is precious to begin with; rash use may miss more critical moments"

text.content: "The Tianji Record fragment in his bosom grew slightly warm. Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into that chaotic gray space. After three breaths, he opened his eyes, his face even paler than before. In the visions there were three possible time points, but each was filled with variables. In the clearest vision, father lay on a cold stone platform, eyes tightly shut, surrounded by eerie black chains—the methods of the Life Guardian. The rescue window was only the length of one incense stick; miss it and it's eternal separation."

dialogue.content: "(After opening his eyes, muttering to himself) One incense stick... that's enough."

choices.description: "Expose no intentions, slowly pursue through other channels, await a more mature opportunity"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain disguise integrity, avoid startling the enemy"
choices.risk_hint: "Father's Heavenly Fate is being continuously extracted; time is his very life"

text.content: "Chen Ji tucked the transmission talisman back into his bosom, his expression gradually returning to its usual indifference. Impulsiveness is the privilege of the weak. He had endured for so many years in the Tianqing Sect, never would he destroy an entire chess game due to momentary emotional fluctuation. Father's situation was indeed urgent, but precisely at times like this, calm was needed. He required more intelligence—the internal structure of the observatory heavenly prison, the guard rotation patterns, the true identity of the Life Guardian... none of this could be uncovered in a single day. He closed his eyes, beginning to sketch a vast net in his mind."

choices.description: "Seek guidance from Mo Xiansheng slumbering within the Tianji Record; perhaps key information can be obtained"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Mo Xiansheng's esoteric knowledge about the Life Guardian and the Chen family's fate"
choices.risk_hint: "Every answer from Mo Xiansheng is profound, possibly drawing out even greater mysteries"

text.content: "Chen Ji flipped open the first page of the Tianji Record; the ink marks squirmed like living things. After a moment, that aged and ethereal voice arose: 'Life Guardian... so you've finally found it.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before. 'That person was once a disciple of the Tianqing Sect,同期 with your father. He was chosen to become the Life Guardian not because of strength, but because his fate configuration counteracts your father's.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Contemporary disciple? Counteracting fate configurations? The scheming here ran far deeper than what appeared on the surface."

"Just as Chen Ji was immersed in thought, the night wind outside the window suddenly stopped. That abrupt silence like an invisible hand, strangling the throat of the entire room. Chen Ji's body instantly tensed, his right hand already touching the short blade in his sleeve. He didn't turn around, but his perception spread out like spider silk. The visitor's aura was eerily suppressed, like a mass of mist walking through shadows. Had it not been for his years of honed alertness, he wouldn't have detected a trace. Those who could approach him silently within the Tianqing Sect could be counted on one hand. And this person's aura... carried an unsettling familiarity. Chen Ji slowly turned around; in the next instant, his pupils slightly contracted. On the window lattice, a slender figure stood with hands clasped behind its back, a black long skirt fluttering in the night wind. That妖异 face flickered uncertainly under the moonlight, the corner of the mouth carrying a meaningful smile—it was Ye Qing."

dialogue.content: "(Tilting his head slightly, eyes sparkling with inquiry) Chen Ji, your disguise fooled the entire Tianqing Sect, but not me. The moment you learned of Chen Tianming's whereabouts, your surrounding aura changed—that kind of气息, I've seen countless times in the Holy Sect's prisons. Despair, rage, and... a killing intent forcibly suppressed."

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't speak. He simply静静地 watched the woman on the windowsill, his gaze like looking at merchandise waiting to be priced. Ye Qing's smile faltered slightly—she sensed keenly that Chen Ji's current state was completely different from what she had anticipated. No panic, no anger, not even that tension of someone whose secret had been exposed. He was simply... calculating. This calm reminded Ye Qing of those old monsters who had lived for hundreds of years in the Holy Sect. But she quickly suppressed her emotions, drawing from her sleeve a card emanating ghostly light, turning it gently between her fingertips. The patterns on the card's surface were faint and shifting, emanating a heart-stopping fluctuation. Chen Ji's eyes finally moved. That aura on the card... was the ultimate condensation of Heavenly Fate. More importantly, that blurry outline on the card's face—Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted."

dialogue.content: "(Tossing the card toward Chen Ji, voice low) This is one of the fate cards I brought out from the Holy Sect. The information recorded on it concerns your father—specifically, the entrance location and guard configuration of the observatory heavenly prison. Of course, this isn't free."

text.content: "Chen Ji caught the card, his thumb gently stroking its surface. That eerie resonance grew even stronger—this card didn't just record information, it itself was like a fragment, connected to the Tianji Record within him by some inexplicable tie. He looked up, his gaze toward Ye Qing gaining several degrees of scrutiny: 'What do you want?' Ye Qing hopped down from the windowsill, her black skirt cutting an elegant arc in the moonlight. She walked to Chen Ji, the two of them close enough to feel each other's breath. 'I want a fate card from your hand.' She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes. 'Not the cards that are the Tianji Record itself—but those you have already condensed, the ones usable for trading.'"

choice.prompt: "Ye Qing's conditions were clear and direct—exchange one fate card for Chen Tianming's positional intelligence. Chen Ji did have several cards obtained through various channels, but he also knew well that in this chaotic world, every card could be a trump card saving his life at a critical moment."

choices.description: "Hand over one card, obtain complete intelligence and Ye Qing's promise of assistance"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain complete intelligence on the observatory heavenly prison, as well as a strategic-level alliance with the Demonic Path Holy Maiden"
choices.risk_hint: "Lose a trump card that might change fate at a critical moment"

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't hesitate long. He drew from his bosom a dark golden card—a chip he had purchased at great cost at an auction, originally intended as a last-resort保命手段. The moment the card left his hand, he felt a fine thread in his river of destiny vanish. But at the same time, the card Ye Qing handed over grew slightly warm in his palm, as if finally finding its place of belonging."

dialogue.content: "(Taking the card, a strange glint flashing in her eyes) You are more decisive than I imagined. For a person who might not be saved, willing to give up your trump card—Chen Ji, you are more qualified to be called insane than me."

choices.memory_label: 与夜清完成第一次实质性交易，建立了基于利益交换的盟友关系

choices.description: "Point out that Ye Qing also needs his help, attempt to obtain intelligence at a lower cost"
choices.visible_cost: "No consumption but may provoke Ye Qing"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain intelligence at a lower cost while probing Ye Qing's bottom line"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's personality is fierce; negotiation breakdown may cost this ally"

text.content: "Chen Ji tucked the card back into his bosom, a faint smile curving his lips: 'Holy Maiden Ye's information is indeed valuable, but don't forget—you are currently on Tianqing Sect territory as well. If we cooperate, both parties profit; if negotiations collapse...' He didn't finish, but the meaning was crystal clear. A dangerous glint flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, but was quickly replaced by something more complex. She suddenly laughed, her voice carrying genuine admiration:"

dialogue.content: "(A light laugh escaping her, eyes sparkling with admiration) Interesting. The reports say this is Tianqing Sect's废物 servant, yet actually dares to bargain with the Demonic Path Holy Maiden. Fine, I'll make one concession—you provide me with something else, doesn't have to be a card."

choices.description: "Seek other methods to obtain intelligence, owe Ye Qing no favor"
choices.visible_cost: "Lose the opportunity for quick intelligence acquisition"
choices.risk_hint: "Solo investigation may expose intentions, time cost enormous"

text.content: "Chen Ji placed the card back in his bosom, his expression cold: 'Holy Maiden Ye's kindness is appreciated, but I'll decline the transaction. Although Chen Ji may be废物, I don't fancy owing people favors.' Ye Qing's gaze slightly froze, seemingly not expecting such a direct refusal. But she quickly suppressed her emotions, her smile deepening instead:"

dialogue.content: "(Clapping lightly, eyes sparkling with admiration) Interesting.废物? Chen Ji, do you know what type of person I dislike most? —Those who are clearly full of secrets yet insist on pretending they have nothing. You are exactly that kind of person. But never mind, I'm waiting for the day you come around."

text.content: "Ye Qing didn't say anything more. She simply gave Chen Ji one long, deep look—those eyes contained far too much he couldn't read—investigation, curiosity, and a thread of... anticipation? The next moment, her figure vanished into the night as eerily as it had arrived, leaving only the faintly swaying shadows on the window lattice. Chen Ji stood alone in the moonlight, the fate card clutched in his hand. Information from the card flooded his mind like a tide—the observatory heavenly prison's location, the guard rotation schedule, even a portrait of the Life Guardian. It was a middle-aged man with a blurred face, wearing outdated night watchman's attire, surrounded by unsettling death energy. Chen Ji closed his eyes, carving every piece of information into his memory. After a long while, he opened his eyes, deep within his pupils burning a cold flame. Father's fate, from this moment on, would be rewritten by his own hands. Whether the road ahead was a dragon's pool or a tiger's den, he would not retreat. The Chen family's debt was time to settle."
